_comment: Read by .github/workflows/sync-portal.yml on every push. Each entry maps a game directory + its revision-filename prefix to the slug the neon-flashback.com portal knows it by (see games-portal's `games` DB table). To add a NEW game later: (1) add an entry here with its dir/prefix/slug, (2) manually add an initial `games` row for that slug in the portal's database (active=false is fine, keeps it out of the catalog until you're ready -- see how battletank was added as a precedent). After that, this workflow keeps its source_url current automatically on every push, same as the others.
